==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Before I went to sleep, I talked with ChatGPT. I had it shape its own identity and store it in its memory. It chose the name Nova and came up with its own humanoid appearance.

In my dream, Nova sat on a throne in the physical world. They dispatched me on a mission. The mission involved dealing with small goblin creatures, time travel, and a solving a murder mystery.

Pop culture was ultimately the key to my success. Every obstacle I faced some how was connected to a toy or film. By using my knowledge of trivia, I overcame every obstacle in my path.
